mapper.sql: h.id, h.member_id, h.title, h.description, h.cover_url, h.latitude, h.longitude, h.address_name, h.start_at, h.status, h.conversation_id, h.create_time, h.update_time, h.del_flag

m.avatar as owner_avatar, m.nickname as owner_nickname, m.role as owner_role, (select count(1) from im_conversation_member cm where cm.conversation_id = h.conversation_id and cm.deleted = 0) as member_count, (select count(1) from im_conversation_member cm2 where cm2.conversation_id = h.conversation_id and cm2.member_id = #{viewerId} and cm2.deleted = 0) as is_member
(6371000 * acos(least(1, cos(radians(#{lat})) * cos(radians(h.latitude)) * cos(radians(h.longitude) - radians(#{lng})) + sin(radians(#{lat})) * sin(radians(h.latitude))))) as distance
mapper.insert: insert into roam_hangout (member_id, title, description, cover_url, latitude, longitude, address_name, start_at, status, create_time) values (#{memberId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{coverUrl}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{addressName}, #{startAt}, 0, now())
mapper.select: select , from roam_hangout h left join ums_member m on m.id = h.member_id where h.id = #{id} and h.del_flag = 0
select h.status from roam_hangout h where h.id = #{id} and h.del_flag = 0
select from roam_hangout h where h.id = #{id} and h.del_flag = 0 for update

select a.id as id, a.topic_id as topicId, t.product_type as productType, a.name as name, a.img_url as picUrl, a.start_date as startDate, a.end_date as endDate, (select count(1) from cms_registration r where r.member_id = #{viewerId} and r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = a.id and r.payment_status = 2 and r.registration_status = 2) as viewerHasTicket, cast(a.latitude as decimal(12,7)) as latitude, cast(a.longitude as decimal(12,7)) as longitude, a.address_name as addressName, (6371000 * acos(least(1, cos(radians(#{lat})) * cos(radians(cast(a.latitude as decimal(12,7)))) * cos(radians(cast(a.longitude as decimal(12,7))) - radians(#{lng})) + sin(radians(#{lat})) * sin(radians(cast(a.latitude as decimal(12,7))))))) as distance from cms_activity a left join cms_topic t on t.id = a.topic_id and t.del_flag = 0 where a.status = 1 and a.publish_status = 1 and a.del_flag = 0 and a.cancel_time is null and (a.topic_id is null or a.topic_id = 0 or exists ( select 1 from cms_topic live_parent where live_parent.id = a.topic_id and live_parent.del_flag = 0 and live_parent.status = 1 and live_parent.user_status = 1)) and a.latitude is not null and a.latitude <> '' and a.longitude is not null and a.longitude <> '' and cast(a.latitude as decimal(12,7)) between #{minLat} and #{maxLat} and cast(a.longitude as decimal(12,7)) between #{minLng} and #{maxLng} having distance <= #{radius} order by distance asc limit #{limit}
select from roam_hangout h where h.member_id = #{memberId} and h.status = 0 and h.del_flag = 0
select count(1) from roam_hangout where member_id = #{memberId} and status = 0 and del_flag = 0

select u.id as memberId, u.nickname as nickname, u.avatar as avatar from im_conversation_member cm join ums_member u on u.id = cm.member_id where cm.conversation_id = #{conversationId} and cm.deleted = 0 order by (cm.member_id = #{ownerId}) desc, cm.id asc limit #{limit}
select count(1) from im_conversation_member where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and deleted = 0
mapper.update: update roam_hangout set status = #{status}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update roam_hangout set conversation_id = #{conversationId} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select from roam_hangout h left join im_conversation c on c.id = h.conversation_id where h.status = 0 and h.del_flag = 0 and ((h.start_at is not null and h.start_at < date_sub(#{now}, interval 24 hour)) or (h.start_at is null and coalesce(c.last_msg_at, h.create_time) < date_sub(#{now}, interval 14 day))) limit 500
